title: ElevatorFaultCase
description: Validated schema for elevator fault diagnostics and predictive maintenance knowledge base records.

source_title.description: Human-readable title of the original document, ticket, or log.

source_reference.description: Unique reference ID, URL, service request number, or technical bulletin identifier.

source_type.description: Origin category of the fault case record.

verification_status.description: Verification state of the diagnostic findings.

subsystem.description: Functional elevator subsystem where the fault occurred.

fault_code.description: Standard or manufacturer-specific fault diagnostic code (e.g., 'E-DR-201').

symptoms.description: List of observed physical, operational, or sensory symptoms.

telemetry_summary.description: Key-value dictionary summarizing sensor readings, statistics, or state flags.

confirmed_root_cause.description: Diagnosed physical, electrical, or firmware root cause.

corrective_action.description: Detailed repair, calibration, or maintenance steps executed.

timestamp.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp string of the incident or record creation.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata dictionary. Enforces 'is_synthetic: true' if source_type is synthetic_illustrative.

is_synthetic.description: Explicit provenance flag distinguishing synthetic benchmark examples from verified historical records.

is_indexed.description: Flag indicating whether this record has been indexed into vector storage.
